name: rest-api-client
description: Send API_KEY-authenticated requests to the Analyticom soccer API without exposing its secret.

interface.longDescription: Send HTTP requests to the Analyticom soccer API. The local MCP server reproduces the required BC Soccer request headers, injects API_KEY from the environment, and never exposes the credential to the model.
